newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Rugby union-Ireland's Corkery still hopeful.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Ireland's Corkery still hopeful.

text.p: Irish flanker David Corkery has not given up hope of playing against England in the Five Nations championship at Lansdowne Road on February 15.
Corkery, 24, damaged the third finger on his right hand when making a tackle in the 26-25 defeat of Wales in Cardiff and X-rays this week confirmed a cracked bone.
"The bone is cracked but the good thing is that the finger joints are not in any way damaged or giving me trouble and that gives me some hope," Corkery said.
"I have 10 days to recover and I would see my chances as about 50-50."
Ireland winger Simon Geoghegan, due to make his comeback appearance for Bath seconds on Saturday after a long-lay off with a toe injury, has had to delay his return.
Geoghegan, whose last appearance for Ireland was against England last March, has been ruled out by a calf muscle strain.
